scope: WS7 3D systems, frontend side (DankoLiv with Claude Code): the lazily loaded three.js scene and its pure modules in frontend/src/three/ (Kepler orbits, blackbody and CIE 1931 colour, SPHEREx IR and D1-D6 colour modes, limb darkening, glow, layout, Dataset time on the SPHEREx pass dates, ephemerides, SPHEREx coverage windows, predicted sky track, 'How this body is drawn' notes) with their vitest tests, and the 3D viewer, body panel and system pages; plus, on branch ws7/measured-3d (V13, with V4 and V12; not merged when this record was written, so it has no pull request entry), the removal of the class-typical toggle and its invented surface features on real targets, the 'colour unknown' and 'size unknown · not to scale' rendering, R Dra drawn at constant radius, the fact-origin chips (factOrigin.ts) and the V4/V12 texts of the WS3 review in docs/SCIENCE.md. The pipeline side of the same work is recorded in pipeline/errante/systems/ai-usage.json
real_target_validation_basis: A 3D model of a target is not an R05 validation (AGENTS.md rule 3). The formal per-target validation records are the coordinator's (docs/validation/) and their human review is pending (docs/VALIDATION.md); the 3D views draw catalog values and show the 'seen by SPHEREx' facts copied from those records, not new measurements
human_review: DankoLiv directs the WS7 work done with Claude Code, chooses its design decisions and reviews the changes, including in the browser; that review is in progress and is not claimed complete, and a line-by-line human review of the code or tests is not claimed

integration_validation.source: systems JSON built from catalog and literature values (pipeline/errante/systems); no SPHEREx pixel is drawn in 3D, and the SPHEREx light curves are shown by WS5's LightCurvePanel, not by the 3D
integration_validation.arbitrary_coordinate_job: not part of WS7: there is no 3D for an arbitrary click yet (V14, future work)
integration_validation.golden_fields: the five published systems open at #/system/<id> in the real dataset and link to and from their real SPHEREx fields (#64; checked in the browser, tasks/WS7-3d-systems.md)

#64: the system page names its field's target in the SPHEREx link (fieldLink.ts, vitest)

These ran as AI agents in Claude Code: they are AI reviews, not human reviews. WS3's scientific review of the merged 3D (#65, docs/SCIENCE.md) is WS3's record, not this one
idea_origin: Not covered by this record: the product vision, including the rule that the 3D is built only from measurements, was stated by the team (docs/VISION.md; AI_USAGE.md, 'Origin of the product vision'). DankoLiv chose the WS7 design decisions recorded in docs/VISION_3D.md (SPHEREx IR false colour by default, smooth spheres, no contract change, removing the class-typical toggle) from options proposed in Claude Code sessions

rendered_products.paths: #/systems and #/system/<id>[/<body>]: three.js scenes drawn in the browser by frontend/src/three/ from <root>/systems/<id>.json
rendered_products.origin: Client-side renders of model values computed by the AI-assisted WS7 code from the systems JSON (blackbody colour, grey-atmosphere limb darkening, Kepler orbits, display scaling); not AI-generated imagery and not SPHEREx images. 'fields' lists the real SPHEREx fields the systems link to through field_id
rendered_products.labels: Every view shows '3D MODEL · NOT AN IMAGE' and the representation_note; the SPHEREx colour modes carry a FALSE COLOUR · BLACKBODY MODEL chip; values no source gives are drawn as 'colour unknown' or 'size unknown · not to scale'; the synthetic demo system keeps its procedural textures and the SYNTHETIC DATA badge
rendered_products.nasa_branding: No NASA logo, flag or mission identifier was generated, added or modified
